definition: Tal Arbel is a professor of electrical engineering at McGill University who specialises in computer vision.
details: She is interested in the application of artificial intelligence in healthcare.
story: Picture a child pointing at pictures in a book — cat, car, cloud — learning to see by seeing a thousand examples. It turns a picture into an understanding: this is a cat, that is a stop sign. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. It is eyes made of arithmetic — pixels become edges, edges become shapes, shapes become meaning. And that is Tal Arbel — giving a machine the gift of sight.
